related_formalizations.note: Copies literal generic complex GEPP, finite-maxima and original-row-label definition bodies into the independent IE13 namespace; exact reuse hashes and explicit semantic bridge are retained. No problem-specific bound or proof is imported.
Real scaled-LU trajectory and pivot code inspected as implementation references; no deterministic tie rule or real-only hypothesis is imposed on the IE13 universal complex target.
Numerical-first, kernel-only LeanCert and Comparator evidence patterns.
Independent Challenge and separate proof organization studied.

methods.tool_setup: Multiple independent problem agents; source drafting on macOS, all actual Lean and Comparator execution assigned to non-root Linux. No local Lean/Lake or cache downloads.
methods.prompting_notes: Write full numerical statements first, then literal definitions and independent contracts. Preserve all bandwidth endpoints, complex entries, every pivot tie, every active stage, actual nonsingularity and rational attainment. Use exact recurrence and finite-subset bounds in place of sorting or growing interval boxes. Require two independent statement approvals and actual elaboration before freezing and proofs.

automation.notes: Draft prepared by /root/next_elimination. No proof implementation or mechanical acceptance claimed. Full independent source and runtime referees are later gates; no human peer review or official Tau Ceti endorsement.

status.scope: Full original IE13 sharp bound G(0,q)=1 and G(p,q)=h_p(p+q) for p≥1, over every required unequal pair and every allowed dimension, actual complex input and GEPP tie path, with exact rational-real attainment. Current phase is unapproved definitions and 28 deliberate independent Challenge placeholders only.

fidelity.divergences: Zero-based Fin indices and zero-padded inactive Schur blocks replace one-based active matrices. A structurally recursive history register implements the integer recurrence, with exported correspondence. Actual arbitrary input scale is retained. Finite-subset envelope bounds replace sorting without weakening the domain. An explicitly proved prefix-extension lemma can complete the witness after its attaining entry is visible. The source matrix is defined first over rational numbers and then embedded into complex numbers; no preliminary algorithmic permutation is introduced.

review.status: Pending two independent full statement approvals and actual Linux elaboration. No freeze or proof authorization yet.
review.notes: Apply scoped Tau Ceti fidelity, proof-quality, reuse/API and attribution standards to all definitions and all 28 contracts. Check maxima, recurrence indexing, every zero-bandwidth case, nonvacuous paths, original-row witness support and actual prefix extension. Final acceptance requires two nonimplementing referees plus genuine LeanCert/default-kernel/Comparator and rejection/sandbox controls.
